description: Source code for security certificate management, including initialization, parsing, and retrieval of certificate details, supporting multiple SSL/TLS libraries (OpenSSL, WolfSSL, mbedTLS).

methods.name: init_certificate
methods.description: Initializes a certificate profile with path, certificate object, and associated DM section.

methods.name: get_certificate_md
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the message digest algorithm used in a certificate (mbedTLS).

methods.name: get_certificate_pk
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the public key type used in a certificate (mbedTLS).

methods.name: get_certificate_sig_alg
methods.description: Returns the signature algorithm string based on NID (OpenSSL).

methods.name: generate_serial_number
methods.description: Generates a serial number string from binary data.

methods.name: fill_certificate_paths
methods.description: Populates the certificate paths array from a directory.

methods.name: get_certificate_paths
methods.description: Retrieves certificate paths from system and configuration.

methods.name: browseSecurityCertificateInst
methods.description: Iterates over stored certificates, parses them, and creates DM instances.

methods.name: get_Security_CertificateNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Returns the number of certificate entries.

methods.name: get_SecurityCertificate_LastModif
methods.description: Retrieves last modification time of a certificate.

methods.name: get_SecurityCertificate_SerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number of a certificate.

methods.name: get_SecurityCertificate_Issuer
methods.description: Retrieves the issuer of a certificate.

methods.name: get_SecurityCertificate_NotBefore
methods.description: Retrieves the not-before validity date of a certificate.

methods.name: get_SecurityCertificate_NotAfter
methods.description: Retrieves the not-after validity date of a certificate.

methods.name: get_SecurityCertificate_Subject
methods.description: Retrieves the subject of a certificate.

methods.name: get_SecurityCertificate_SignatureAlgorithm
methods.description: Retrieves the signature algorithm of a certificate.
